name: trustedstake
description: TrustedStake — non-custodial Bittensor index staking, as one mod. A delegator signs one addProxy(<index proxy>, Staking) extrinsic and keeps custody of their TAO while an index manager rebalances that stake across subnets; revoking the proxy ends it. This module is the manager desk over the platform's Manager API: list strategies, set subnet weights, pause and resume, queue a manual rebalance, read the trading engine's activity log and the delegator roster. BYOK — a scoped ts_mk_ key lives off-tree at ~/.mod/trustedstake/key.json (0600); the module holds no house key, signs no extrinsic, and can write only to the caller's own strategies. Weights are validated locally (must sum to 100) before any call is spent. Python stdlib only, no server, no dependencies.
backend: python stdlib only (urllib) — CLI + library, no port, no server

layout.mod.py: the anchor — the Manager API client, the weight parser, every fn
layout.README.md: what the platform is, what this wraps, and what it refuses to do

byok.get_keys: https://app.trustedstake.ai — Manager → Settings → API Keys (wallet signature required)

scopes.strategies:write: create, update, delete, pause, resume, whitelist

byok.note: keys are scoped and expire (90d default, 365d max); every call spends the caller's own 130 req/min budget against their own strategies

custody.model: non-custodial via the Substrate proxy pallet (Staking proxy type)
custody.delegator_action: addProxy(<index proxy account>, Staking) — signed in the delegator's own wallet
custody.exit: revoke the proxy (the platform's withdraw button) — principal never moves off the coldkey
custody.this_module: signs nothing, holds no seed, reads no delegator key; writes only strategy definitions owned by the caller's key

limits.rebalance: auto: hourly when profitability thresholds are met; manual: immediate, daily cap per strategy

fees.basis: staking yield (validator dividends) only — never the principal

env.TRUSTEDSTAKE_API_KEY: manager key used when a call carries none
